title: Evaluator submission refused 409 "source root changed while it was evaluated" although the evaluated work's root, claim and generation did not change (worktree also named by a second item)
outcome: Evaluator submission refused 409 "source root changed while it was evaluated" although the evaluated work's root, claim and generation did not change (worktree also named by a second item)
acceptance: The holder's note identifies, with file:line, the host state that makes acceptance_evaluation_root_changed_locked refuse a submission whose evaluated root, claim, generation and naming revision are unchanged, and the host path that creates that state around the requesting session's next turn.

A fail-first test requests an evaluation on a named root, then puts the work's naming authority into the state a source-root reconcile guard leaves (unresolved, not published) without any naming change, and shows the submission refused as final on the unchanged code.

With the fix, that submission is accepted and recorded, while a real change during the evaluation (a re-name to a new generation, a different root, a lost or displaced claim, or a pending naming event for the work) is still refused as final; tests cover each case.
The full gate passed on the exact landed input.
